_source: Saint cards (owner scans 2026-11-21). Rulebook p.68–69: Holy Infusion by Devotion tokens, Holy Commandment, Holy Incarnation.

saints.name: Eudes
saints.title: Saint Eudes — The Conduit of Fortitude
saints.commandment: Other Knights cannot use any abilities on you.
infusionText: 3 Devotion: Your [red Armor die] becomes [black Armor die].
5 Devotion: Your [black Armor die] becomes [white Armor die].

incarnation.name: Conduit of Fortitude Incarnation
incarnation.text: Knight Power die one tier higher. +3 [Power]. Immune to Body Condition cards. Braced.

saints.name: Linde
saints.title: Saint Linde — The Font of Faith
saints.commandment: You cannot re-roll your Crit die.
infusionText: 3 Devotion: When you attack, you may lose -3 [Vigor] to gain +1 [Power].
4 Devotion: When you perform a [Attack action], gain +1 [Passion].

incarnation.name: Martyr of Anatiocha Incarnation
incarnation.text: Knight Power die one tier higher. +3 [Precision]. +2 [Power]. Auto-break 3. When you are about to lose [Vigor], gain that much [Vigor] instead.

unclear: 4 Devotion line: the red icon is read as [Attack action]
